author: 8BitSteve
quote: Home Depot simulator that's beyond bug riddled. They did NOTHING of value during the 13 years of development. Get a refund when you still can. I did.

author: 8BitSteve
quote: This game isn't anywhere near as bad as other reviews are suggesting, despite some bugs at launch. Turning fnaf into an adventure game suprisingly was loads of fun and offers more variety to the series. I know I'll replay it again down the line. Also, the 80s glamrock touch, although not scary, is pretty awesome. I honestly hope to see more games like this for the series in the future.
game_title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach

author: 8BitSteve
quote: Honestly, I couldn't of asked for anything more. For a series that I loved to come back and remain mostly true to its original formula is amazing. Especially since multiple producers have done crash dirty for over 10 years. This is a very hard game game. However, it is very rewarding.
